title: Grill skill asks a follow-up for vague criteria
body:
### Summary

As a product strategist, I want the grill skill to ask one follow-up when a criterion is vague, so that every criterion can be observed.

### Completion Goal

1. [api-trace] state: the grill prompt for a story over MCP; expected: the question set tells the host to ask one follow-up when an expected outcome names no observable result

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 1 criteria

### Scenario

Request the grill story prompt through `aayu mcp` and read its question set.

### Environment

local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production
